1.1a.1.subject: Virtuoso 23 Application Status
1.1a.1.body:
Dear Mark Borja,

Thank you for your interest in joining [b]Virtuoso 23[/b]. After reviewing the applications we received, yours was not selected for further consideration per our selection criteria.

We would like to remind our applicants that we can only select a few new members as we try to make space for more every year. Thank you for taking the time to submit the requirements and other application matters. The selection board appreciates your participation in our program.

We open our doors to worthy pianists every year so keep practicing! We wish you success with your passion as a musician and as a pianist!

Best wishes,
[img=320]res://assets/pictures/ch1sc1a/erika_email_sign.png[/img]

It isn't fair none of this is fair the world is ending and you're not here

5.8.mom_draft_5.subject: adsdff
5.8.mom_draft_5.body:
Mom,

Hi, how have you been? It would mean a lot to me and dad if you could let us know you're okay. I know you're probably just busy with work, but the news really worried us, and then all this other stuff happened with the earthquakes all over. Please just let us know, okay?

5.8.mom_draft_6.subject: sorry
5.8.mom_draft_6.body:
Dear Mom,

I'm sorry. I'm sorry for everything. I wish you and dad never left. I understand why you did, and I'm thankful for it. But this isn't worth it. I'm not worth it.

I can't eat I can't sleep I can't do anything. Dad is hysterical. We really miss you. Please let us know you're okay. Please come home mom. I promise I'll never ask for anything again. I'll work harder in school. I'll do anything.

Just please come back.
Please come back.

5.8.mom_draft_7.subject: (no subject)
5.8.mom_draft_7.body:
Dear Mom,

I got to talk to dad on the phone today. He says work has been really busy, and it looks like it's going to get busier. I hope he gets a rest day soon. He always sounds tired when I see him. Make sure to tell him to get lots of rest, ok?

I hope you're doing okay too. I know working abroad is really different and demanding. I hope your boss gives you enough breaks and days off. It would be really nice if you could both come home.

Mark

5.8.mom_draft_8.subject: fgadsf
5.8.mom_draft_8.body:
Mom

Please just tell me you're okay I don't know what to do anymore

5.8.mom_draft_9.subject: sdfads
5.8.mom_draft_9.body:
Hi Mom,

I've got big news. Ridel got his big break and he's in talks to start filming his very own movie. Isn't that cool? At this point, Cathy and I can only hope he doesn't get a big head and forget us.

The two of us stayed up last night playing our favorite racing game. Don't worry, I promise I'm still getting enough sleep. Maybe even too much. I'm starting to think I should do something more productive of my time, like Ridel and his movie.

You should come home and we can see it when it's done! It's still a long while away, so that should be enough time to get prepared, right? I'm sure Ridel would be extra touched if you wanted to see it. Hopefully dad can come home too.

Meanwhile, school is the same as ever. You know, I'm really grateful to you and dad for everything, but sometimes I look at where our tuition is going (the principal's crusty makeup) and wonder if that money couldn't have gone elsewhere.

I'm just kidding. I promise I'm still going to class. Don't work yourself too hard, okay? 

Mark

5.8.mom_draft_10.subject: hi
5.8.mom_draft_10.body:
Dear mom,

I've decided I'm going to try out for the piano club this year. I've been practicing Grieg's Wedding Day, and I'm totally a little less terrible than I was before. That's progress, right?

Hopefully I'll master it before you come home. It's looking a little dicey, but I'll put my blood, sweat, and tears into practicing everyday. Just like you did. I won't stop until you hear a performance you can be proud of!

So come home soon, okay? I really want you to see it. I promise I won't let you down.

Mark

5.8.mom_draft_11.subject: (no subject)
5.8.mom_draft_11.body:
Hi Mom,

I miss you. I miss hearing from you.

It's been eight months now. I don't know what else to say. I hope you're taking care of yourself, wherever you are. Maybe you're playing the piano somewhere. Maybe you're still working too much. Probably that. 

Dad and I are always waiting for you, so don't be afraid to reach out, ok? We're not mad, I promise. We just want to hear back from you.

I really miss you, mom.

Love,
Mark
